title: The Cottages Beyond Reaching

features.name: the-row-that-recedes
features.desc-on-touch: you can count the cottages: three clear, five blurred, then only shapes suggesting shelter; each diminished by distance but still distinct, still occupied, still sorting.

features.name: fence-lines-that-teach-distance
features.desc-on-touch: the fence retreats with the cottages, parallel lines converging toward a point you can never reach; each post marks a child's reach, growing smaller as the row extends.

features.name: sorting-work-still-visible-in-the-far-cottages
features.desc-on-touch: you see shapes moving at windows too distant to resolve; children sorting in cottages you cannot reach, the archive's reach ending before their work does.

features.name: the-near-cottage-where-sorting-is-complete
features.desc-on-touch: this one is filled; nothing leaves, everything stays in the row of reach; the sorting work finished here and the doors closed, keeping what was sorted safe inside.

features.name: the-distance-itself-as-a-taught-thing
features.desc-on-touch: the children have learned that reaching ends; that some cottages exist to teach what distance means; that the row continues forever toward a point that recedes.

inscription: the children sorted; the cottages learned; now nothing leaves, and everything stays in the row of reach

file.name: Sorting_Work_Ledgers_1995-2008.txt
file.note: records of what was sorted in each cottage; entries for distant cottages increasingly fragmentary, handwriting itself stretching toward unreachable places
